article.story: BOSTON -- — Robert Hinton scored 20 points as Harvard beat Brown 56-53 on Friday night. Tey Barbour shot 5 for 10 (3 for 7 from 3-point range) and 4 of 5 from the free-throw line to add 17 points for the Crimson (14-9, 7-2 Ivy League). Barbour made two free throws with four seconds left for a three-point lead. Landon Lewis led the way for the Bears (7-15, 1-8) with 17 points, six rebounds, four assists and two steals. Brown also got 10 points and two blocks from Isaiah Langham. The Bears prolonged their losing streak to six straight. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
